sourceOfTruth.warning: The develop workflow labelled Development currently deploys the live production API. prod must not be advanced until launch gates pass.

changes: Durable per-device receipt IDs and bounded retries for confirmed transient failures
No automatic resend on ambiguous timeout or missing receipt; classify unknown
Receipt-only processing after kickoff; no new reminders after kickoff
Ownership-aware invalid-token pruning, current event access checks and expiry
Atomic schedule and generation resets including series and fixture imports
Explicit opt-in, safe rapid toggle handling and device-permission warning
Saved device timezone and legacy club-wide preference repair
migrationOrder: Deploy new API only after both additive migrations succeed
limits: The legacy sent boolean means processing completed, not phone display; deliveryState gives per-device accepted, failed or unknown outcome
Expo receipts prove APNs/FCM acceptance, not display; physical locked-phone testing remains required
A crash after provider acceptance but before DB commit can still duplicate a send; Expo has no application idempotency guarantee
Legacy quiet-hour rows without timezone retain prior interpretation until settings are saved
These changes do not add durable delivery to unrelated chat or broadcast paths
No production sign-in or billing readiness claim is part of this release

physicalTests.iOS: Pending: user has an iPhone; connection and observed locked-screen receipt required
physicalTests.Android: Blocked: user has no physical Android device available; emulator is not delivery proof

productionPromotion: Blocked until launch readiness and physical-device gates pass; do not push prod or start EAS builds
